name: Product Listing via XML API (Hood.de): Odoo -> marketplace with category tree, images, taxes

parameters.body:
=<api type="public" version="2.0" user="{{ $('API Seting HOOD').item.json.hood_user }}" password="{{ $('API Seting HOOD').item.json.hood_password }}">
  <accountName>{{ $('API Seting HOOD').item.json.hood_user }}</accountName>
  <accountPass>{{ $('API Seting HOOD').item.json.hood_password }}</accountPass>
  <function>itemList</function>
  <itemStatus>shopInventory</itemStatus>
  <listMode>simple</listMode>
  <startAt>1</startAt>
  <groupSize>10</groupSize>
</api>

=<api type="public" version="2.0" user="{{ $('API Seting HOOD').item.json.hood_user }}" password="{{ $('API Seting HOOD').item.json.hood_password }}">
  <accountName>{{ $('API Seting HOOD').item.json.hood_user }}</accountName>
  <accountPass>{{ $('API Seting HOOD').item.json.hood_password }}</accountPass>
  <function>itemDetail</function>
    <accountName>ACME AG</accountName>

=<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<api type="public" version="2.0" user="{{ $('API Seting HOOD').first().json.hood_user }}" password="{{ $('API Seting HOOD').first().json.hood_password }}">
   <function>itemInsert</function>
  <accountName>{{ $('API Seting HOOD').first().json.hood_user }}</accountName>
  <accountPass>{{ $('API Seting HOOD').first().json.hood_password }}</accountPass>
   <items>
    <item>
      <itemMode>shopProduct</itemMode>
      <itemName><![CDATA[{{ $json.itemName }}]]></itemName>
      <description><![CDATA[
        {{ $json.description }}]]></description>
      <price>{{ $json.price }}</price>
      <listPrice>{{ $json.listPrice }}</listPrice>
      <quantity>{{ $json.quantity }}</quantity>
      <salesTax>{{ $json.salesTax }}</salesTax>
      <condition>{{ $json.condition }}</condition>
      <categoryID>{{ $json.categoryID }}</categoryID>
      <itemNumber>{{ $json.itemNumber }}</itemNumber>
      <manufacturer>{{ $json.brand }}</manufacturer>
      <ean>{{ $json.barcode }}</ean>
      <mpn>{{ $json.mpn }}</mpn>
      <weight>{{ $json.weight }}</weight>
      <images>{{ $json.imageListXML }}</images>
      <payOptions>
        <option>{{ $json.payOptions.option[0] }}</option>
      </payOptions>
      <shipmethods> {{ $json.shipmethodsXML }}
      </shipmethods>
      <attributes>
        {{ $json.attributes.attribute }}
      </attributes>
      {{ $json.productInfoUrlXML }}
      <productContactInformation>
      <manufacturer>
        <name><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_name }}]]></name>
        <street><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_street }} {{ $json.eu_responsible_house_no }}]]></street>
        <zip><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_post_code }}]]></zip>
        <city><![CDATA[Seelze]]></city>
        <country2DigitCode><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_country }}]]></country2DigitCode>
        <phone><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_phone_number }}]]></phone>
        <email><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_email }}]]></email>
      </manufacturer>
      <additionalContact>
      <name><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_name }}]]></name>
        <street><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_street }} {{ $json.eu_responsible_house_no }}]]></street>
        <zip><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_post_code }}]]></zip>
        <city><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_town }}]]></city>
        <country2DigitCode><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_country }}]]></country2DigitCode>
        <phone><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_phone_number }}]]></phone>
        <email><![CDATA[{{ $json.eu_responsible_email }}]]></email>
        </additionalContact>
      </productContactInformation>
    </item>
  </items>
</api>
